jobs_results.title: React Developer
jobs_results.description:
Cerebital is a B2B SaaS company that aims to offer a cutting-edge Innovation and Product Lifecycle Management (IPLM) platform on the cloud to businesses worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Front End Developer to join our team. The successful candidate will work closely with our back-end developers to develop and maintain the front end of our web applications.

The Role

You Will Be Responsible For
• Writing well-designed, testable and efficient code.
• Gathering and evaluating user feedback.
• Working as a part of a dynamic team to deliver winning products.
• Providing code documentation and other inputs to technical documents.
• Supporting continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and new technologies and presenting these for architectural review.
• Troubleshooting and debugging to optimise performance.
• Participating in release and sprint planning sessions.

Ideal Profile

Requirements
• Must complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
• Must... have minimum 4-5 years of professional experience with React.
• Proficiency in implementing React Drag & Drop functionality.
• Expertise in React Formik or other form development using React.
• Strong command of Material UI / Tailwind / DevExtreme.
• Experience with React Chart, Timeline, Graphs, and 3D libraries.
• Proficiency in state management with Redux, including actions, reducers, and the Redux store.
• Experience with Agile development methodologies.
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
• Excellent communication and Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• If you are passionate about front-end development and want to work on challenging projects in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain the front end of our web applications using React
• Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate the front-end with the back-end application.
• Write efficient and maintainable code using best practices and design patterns.
• Develop and maintain unit tests for front-end code.
• Use Node.js and related technologies to build server-side applications, APIs, and integrations.
• Participate in code reviews and provide feedback to improve code quality.
• Work closely with the UX/UI team to ensure a seamless user experience.

If you are passionate about front-end development and want to work on challenging projects in a fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Note: This is a 100% remote position and the person can work from home without the need to travel to the office.

What's on Offer?
• Excellent career development opportunities
• Work alongside & learn from best in class talent
• Great work environment

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - React, Conversational AI
jobs_results.description:
Hello!

We're Hubtype, a company passionate about developing bots and customer service automation for businesses. We love working on innovative solutions that simplify the lives of our clients worldwide. Currently, we're on the lookout for a Senior React Developer to join our remote team and evangelize your other teammates with good coding practices.

What will you do?
• You will develop high-quality chatbot applications using React.js, other related technologies and our open-source framework Botonic
• You'll work closely with our conversational design team and other developers to effectively implement new features and enhancements
• You will interact with other teams such as support and customer success to give our clients the best experience
• You'll participate in code reviews and technical discussions to maintain quality and consistency in our projects
• You'll keep your knowledge up-to-date, always staying on top of best practices and technology trends

Requirements

What do you... need?
• Demonstrable experience in developing web applications using React.js, Typescript and related front-end technologies
• Experience working with AWS or similar infrastructure technologies
• Great communication skills and the ability to work effectively in remote teams
• Oh, and let's not forget excellent fluency in English, both written and spoken!

Benefits

What do we offer?
• A competitive salary in the range of 50.000€ to 55.000€ per year, depending on your experience and skills
• The opportunity to be part of a flexible and collaborative remote team
• Challenging projects that will allow you to grow both personally and professionally
• An inclusive, team-oriented work environment where your input will always be valued

B&P
• Hubtype seeks top global talent and we offer a competitive salary
• Full-time remote work
• Working with amazing people from all over the world, with different cultures, experiences, and knowledge
• Vacation: 27 days per year + bank holidays + your birthday + volunteer day
• Workstation budget for making great work happen at home
• Attractive Benefits & Perks Plan, centered in Learning & Development + Wellbeing

If you're excited about joining a team passionate about innovation and ready to dive into new challenges, we'd love to meet you! Please apply to this role using this page. Attach your CV and examples of previous work.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Warm regards, The Hubtype Team

jobs_results.title: SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER (JAVA/REACT)
jobs_results.description:
En Getronics, queremos ampliar nuestro equipo incorporando a un/a Senior Full Stack Developer en modalidad teletrabajo para que forme parte de nuestro equipo trabajando para un gigante en el sector Retail. El horario habitual será de oficina con flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida además de jornada intensiva los viernes y meses de verano.

La persona que se incorpore nos ayudará a realizar el desarrollo evolutivo y correctivo necesario dentro de este gigante mundial retail para que todos sus sistemas funcionen correctamente.

REQUISITOS

-Imprescindible atesorar experiencia mínima de 6-8 años en rol igual o superior trabajando con las siguientes tecnologías:
• Java
• Spring (MVC; Boot; Security)
• Hibernate
• React/Redux
• Maven
• Git
• HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc.

-Preferiblemente tener titulación técnica IT como ciclo profesional de grado superior IT o superior (ingeniería técnica o informática)

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Podrás crearte tu propio plan de formación, seleccionando tus... propios contenidos entre una plataforma propia con más de 15.000 opciones a tu alcance, entre las que encontrarás contenidos acerca de las últimas tecnologías, metodologías ágiles, finanzas personales o salud mental, entre muchas otras opciones.
• Estabilidad, ya que formarás parte de una empresa con 130 años de historia y 4.000 empleados en 23 países, de los cuales, 1.800 están en España.
• Crecimiento profesional. Tendrás acceso a todas las vacantes de Getronics por si quieres dar un salto en tu carrera. Además, ponemos a tu disposición GetLead, un programa destinado a acompañar en el camino a nuestros futuros líderes.
• Formarás parte de un gran equipo con el que crecer día a día.
• Podrás acogerte a retribución flexible para que puedas beneficiarte de aquello que más se ajuste a tus necesidades: ticket restaurante, guardería, transporte, seguro privado…
• Disfrutarás de flexibilidad horaria para que puedas compatibilizar tu vida profesional y personal.

Si consideras que la posición encaja con tu perfil y cumples con los requisitos indicados, ¡INSCRÍBETE AHORA! Estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Senior React Frontend Developer (Lead)
jobs_results.description:
Desde LHH Málaga estamos en búsqueda Senior Software Engineer que haya orientado su carrera hacia el desarrollo frontend.

Concretamente buscamos perfiles con más de 6 años de experiencia en entornos Javascript y Typescript que se hayan especializado en REACT y servicios de trabajo en Cloudflare.

La parte back del producto está en Node, por lo que si has tenido contacto con el framework será un plus importante.

Nuestro cliente trabaja implantando buenas prácticas, siguiendo principios modernos del desarrollo, por lo que todo el conocimiento y experiencia que aportes en TDD, DDD, SOLID, even driven architectures, etc, será un plus muy importante.

La posición es híbrida, con 3 días presenciales en la zona de Mijas/Marbella. Si eres de fuera y te interesa vivir en la Costal del Sol, nuestro cliente tiene un interesante paquete de recolocación.

Ofrecemos Telepeaje si eres de alguna otra zona dentro de la Costa del Sol y lo necesitas.

Si necesitas más detalles sobre el proyecto y... condiciones, no dudes en aplicar o contactarme directamente a luis.marquez@lhh.com

items:
Desde LHH Málaga estamos en búsqueda Senior Software Engineer que haya orientado su carrera hacia el desarrollo frontend.

Concretamente buscamos perfiles con más de 6 años de experiencia en entornos Javascript y Typescript que se hayan especializado en REACT y servicios de trabajo en Cloudflare.

La parte back del producto está en Node, por lo que si has tenido contacto con el framework será un plus importante.

Nuestro cliente trabaja implantando buenas prácticas, siguiendo principios modernos del desarrollo, por lo que todo el conocimiento y experiencia que aportes en TDD, DDD, SOLID, even driven architectures, etc, será un plus muy importante.

La posición es híbrida, con 3 días presenciales en la zona de Mijas/Marbella. Si eres de fuera y te interesa vivir en la Costal del Sol, nuestro cliente tiene un interesante paquete de recolocación.

Ofrecemos Telepeaje si eres de alguna otra zona dentro de la Costa del Sol y lo necesitas.

Si necesitas más detalles sobre el proyecto y... condiciones, no dudes en aplicar o contactarme directamente a luis.marquez@lhh.com

jobs_results.title: Senior React Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Description

What is Exoticca?

Do you like traveling? Do you enjoy the exotic? Do you like challenges? If the answer is YES, welcome to Exoticca!

Exoticca is a company that started in 2013 by professionals specialized in the creation and online distribution of trips. Our mission is to offer our clients the possibility to visit the most beautiful and stimulating places on our planet, though the best holiday packages, at unbelievable prices. We are a highly ambitious and well-funded start-up, backed by top national and international investors that have also participated in the growth of other success stories, such as Glovo, Idealista, among others.

At Exoticca we are looking for people who want to offer their best to create unforgettable experiences for our customers. We are a young, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

What will be your main... functions?

As a Front-end Developer, you will be using mainly JS and its related technologies to design, develop and implement projects derived from the challenges that we take on.

You will take on the Exoticca implementation of new features, redesigns, rebranding, applying new technologies using React:
• React Hooks, Context API and React Query.
• TypeScript for type safety.
• High Test coverage.
• MaterialUI and internal design system for UI.

Your new and fresh ideas will always be welcomed to build software that makes our vision a scalable reality. We look for someone who can step up and lead a project, and really like writing code that can be tested. Be proud of your code!

What will be your challenge?
• Working in the company's main website and back office, implementing new functionalities and requirements.
• Support our product teams with new features across the whole website.
• Address tech debt, improve code, typing, tests across the whole codebase.

Requirements:
• +3 years of experience.
• Experience in React hooks and context API.
• Experience in React Query.
• Experience to increase test coverage.
• TypeScript for type safety.
• Experience working with React Testing library and cypress.
• Internal design system for UI.
• Experience working with Git.
• Good team member who likes to help but also keep focus to get things done.
• An agile mindset, since we work in sync with other teams towards our company OKRs.
• Facilitate problem-solving, working with the team to make them a reality.

Nice to have:
• Experience in SSR/NextJS.
• Experience with MaterialUI
• Experience working with MySQL.
• React hook form.
• Hexagonal architecture.

Benefits:
• Competitive compensation package, in line with job responsibilities and experience.
• Training budget.
• Flexible compensation on transportation and food, also in our private health insurance.
• Flexible working schedule, just make sure you meet your monthly goals!
• Hybrid / Remote working model (Spain), choose the one that fits you. Our office is located at the heart of Barcelona (right next to Plaça Catalunya).
• Permanent contract from the start.
• Travel with Exoticca at reduced prices !!!
• Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you can earn a very nice bonus!
• And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization where teamwork, drive, commitment, resilience and being customer-centric are the core values.

Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law

jobs_results.title: Fullstack Developer (react + python)
jobs_results.description:
На связи Eightify. Наш основной продукт — саммари для YouTube с использованием ChatGPT. Основной рынок — US и UK. Проекту нет ещё и года, но он уже вышел в прибыль!

Это не единственный продукт компании, но все объединяет идея извлечения сути и сигнала из шумного потока информации. Сейчас мы запускаем AI-generated медиа: новости на основе различных источников.

Мы ищем в команду full-time разработчика — Senior Full Stack, который хочет 100% времени делать продукт, без корпоративного bullshit.

Tasks

Чем придётся заниматься?

Фокус на двух вещах
• Классный продукт. Крутой UX и качество summary. Одна функция, которая работает лучше конкурентов. Проверь сам.
• Мы зарабатываем деньги. Провели 20+ A/B тестов монетизации и продолжаем.

У нас нет лишних встреч, долгих обсуждений, бессмысленной бюрократии.

Requirements

Стек?
• Backend — Python / Flask
• Frontend App — React (iframe внутри extension, почти все изменения вносятся сюда)
• Chrome Extension — TypeScript
• iOS App — React... Native
• GCP, Docker, Gitlab, Metabase, Postgres, Stripe

Как понять, что мы сработаемся?
• Ты быстро катишь в прод
• ты умеешь выкинуть лишнее, любишь готовые решения и пользуешься github copilot
• ты делаешь быстро, а мы не мучаем вопросами “ну как там?”
• Ты готов много работать
• от 170 до 240 часов в месяц интенсивной, быстрой и сложной работы
• part-time или совмещение с другим проектом — точно нет
• Ты — senior разработчик
• чтобы делать быстрые костыльные решения нужно быть senior разработчиком, иначе это просто плохие решения
• если ты “перфекционист” или любишь оверинжиниринг — не сможем работать вместе
• опыт и насмотренность: оптимизировать SQL запрос, подключить кеширование в redis, знаешь, что такое нормальное распределение 😅
• опыт работы с Python и React желателен, — онбординг будет быстрее

Benefits

Про условия:
• Удалённая работа
• Контракт с US-компанией
• Зарплата в $$$ — любым способом (банковский перевод, Wise, крипта)
• От 170 до 240 часов в месяц интенсивной, быстрой и сложной работы
• Оплата — от $30 до $40 в час

Почему это классная возможность
• Работа с AI и GPT — на этапе рабочего продукта, а не GPT ради GPT.
• Будешь видеть результат работы: выкатил и видишь изменение метрик через пару дней.
• Работа на рынке US и зарплата в $$$.
• Никаких лишний корпоративных процессов.

Команда?

Твоим руководителем будет Леша Катаев, ex-CTO Skyeng. Каждую неделю Леша тратит целый день, чтобы решить, какие 3-4 задачи дадут максимальный рост. Чтобы ни у кого в команде не было тревоги из-за 500 задач в беклоге.

У нас небольшая команда: 1 разработчик, UX-дизайнер и DevOps инженер.

Это очень крутые ребята. Приятно работать, когда знаешь, что с тобой работают классные люди, которым тоже интересно. Которые разделяют с тобой те же принципы и тот же движ 😅 С которыми приятно общаться и которым можно доверять. Это такая команда.

Наши принципы:
• Цели — продукт, пользователи, выручка, прибыль; не одобрение инвесторов, журналистов, друзей.
• Фокус на цели: на задачах, которые приблизят к результату, никаких “полезных задач”; готовые и простые решения — 🔥, костыльные решения — 🔥
• Рациональное принятие решений и правда.
• Небольшая команда full stack
